title: Peer review of the pesticide risk assessment of the active substance fatty acids from hydrolysed vegetable oils
text:
published: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 15:23:51 +0100 Peer review of the pesticide risk assessment of the active substance fatty acids from hydrolysed vegetable oils

The conclusions of the European Food Safety Authority (EFSA) following the peer review of the initial risk assessments carried out by the competent authorities of the rapporteur Member State, Greece, and co‐rapporteur Member State, Austria, for the pesticide active substance fatty acids from hydrolysed vegetable oils are reported. The context of the peer review was that required by Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) No 844/2012, as amended by Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) No 2018/1659.
